info.name: Event Ticket Booking - All Services
info.description: End-to-end and per-service checks for Catalog (8081), Inventory (8082), Booking (8083) and Payment (8084). Run the folders in order, or the whole collection in the Collection Runner. A full run uses 1 General Admission seat (the confirmed booking); reset with `python scripts/reset_test_inventory.py --yes`.

exec: pm.test("event-catalog and its database are UP", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql("event-catalog"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(b.database).to.eql("UP"); });
pm.test("inventory and its database are UP", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql("inventory"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(b.database).to.eql("UP"); });
pm.test("booking and its database are UP", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql("booking"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(b.database).to.eql("UP"); });

pm.test("payment-mock and its database are UP", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.service).to.eql("payment-mock"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(b.database).to.eql("UP"); });

request.description: Booking calls this to validate the event and read the ticket price (BR6).
